provenance.note: Extruded massing only. The 8x8 km frame is clipped to the Nanshan district polygon, so the Bao'an side of the frame is excluded. Building heights are 3D-GloBFP model estimates; the two Spring Cocoon outlines use the OSM height tag (40m) and the two Tencent Seafront Towers use OSM 245.8m/194.8m. Water is reconstructed by closing the OSM coastline south of the shore and is not collidable. Surface roads use inferred widths; street furniture is procedural. Combined derived data retains ODbL obligations.

boundary.usedFor: buildings and roads clipped to the district inside the bounding box

provenance.boundaryEvidence: Nominatim polygon_geojson for relation/5664195 (南山区, boundary=administrative, admin_level=6), fetched 2026-11-21. Used only to clip buildings/roads to the district; it is not a survey-grade boundary.
provenance.landmarkEvidence: CTBUH building record lists China Resources Tower at 392.5m; OSM way/529272473 supplies the 37-point outline (building:levels 68). Architectural height, not an exact roof model.
provenance.osmLandmarkReference: 3 OSM landmark outlines retained as reference (way/529272473 added as ctbuh massing). 4 OSM building outlines added as ordinary estimate massing (way/665408865, way/665408866, way/694152192, way/694152193, OSM height tags).
